Now I see the full picture clearly:
- MOUSE on a bottom tile (e.g., col 18, row 58) → W frame appears around that tile (cols 17-22, rows 56-61)
- MOUSE on the W frame edge (col 17, row 56) → W frame disappears (removes selection)
- MOUSE on another tile → W frame moves to that tile

The W frame is purely a selection indicator. Clicking on it removes the selection. The tiles don't move.
Now, the key insight: the W frame appears around a 4x4 tile area. The frame is at cols 17-22 (6 wide) and rows 56-61 (6 tall). The tile itself is at cols 18-21 (4 wide) and rows 57-60 (4 tall). So the W frame is a 1-cell border around the 4x4 tile.
When I click on col 17 (the left edge of the W frame), the W frame disappears. This suggests that clicking on the W frame is like "deselecting" or "confirming" the selection.
